gear.name: 行路干粮
gear.desc: 油纸包好的硬面饼和肉干。猎犬抵不住肉干的气味——也可以拿来引开它们。

en.name: Trail Ration
en.desc: Hardtack and dried meat wrapped in oilpaper. Hounds cannot resist the smell — and it can lure them away.

zh-CN.desc: 油纸包好的硬面饼和肉干。猎犬抵不住肉干的气味——也可以拿来引开它们。

gear.name: 兄弟的行囊
gear.desc: 布拉姆兄弟的旧行囊。角落烙着一枚刻名的木哨记号。绷带和口粮已被用去大半，不可购买。

en.name: His Brother’s Pack
en.desc: Bram’s brother’s old pack. A carved wooden whistle is branded into the corner. Most of the bandages and rations are already used. It cannot be purchased.
